## One original owner and closure continuation

The Drive worker calls the original storage.withOwner exactly once around processOwned, spanning original source read/preparation, dispatch, body/projection, final inspect, saved closure and void ACK, finish-proof save/read/consume, closed terminal Tx and any permitted recovery. The local/PDF preparation ownership branches remain their original branches.

The original active lease remains live through processing. The final source inspection runs with that same original lease before finish. The original provider saved-read/confirmSourceAcknowledged is awaited once with its void return contract; no true/false conversion, second consume, copy, artificial ACK or new capability is introduced. finishInput remains the original proof save/read/consume path. The same genuine SourceInputProof and same SourceInputLease are stored by reference. Closure validation requires the original memory.consumed(proof,sameLease), same receipt/source, saved owner token/runtime, zero saved source memory and released original attempts.

DrivePending stores the original awaiting Promise. Genuine closed receipt resolves the closure awaiter, or rejects the original known final-inspect error only after closure was proved. An unknown closed/save/read/native/ACK path keeps the original caller pending and ownership held. The original NodeLlmExecution operation.done continues waiting for the same work callback; no synthetic completion notification or direct deferred resolve is exposed. Successful terminal read-confirmation resolves the same commit Promise and lets the original withOwner callback/finally end naturally. Known malformed/domain final-inspection errors may remain held after genuine resource closure; they are not reported as normal business failure or resource success.

## Typed immutable capture and transaction order

All snapshots are trusted repository/domain data only. Known Date fields become epoch numbers, and nested source/access/owner/outcome/receipt-consumer/dispatch-response structures and arrays are copied/frozen. No provider-native error properties, getter, private proof fields or native brands are inspected. Existing domain identifiers and typed fields stay inside SOURCE, never public output.

| Snapshot | Capture point | Exact contents and purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DriveLlmPrewrite | Same original Tx, BEFORE FIRSTWRITE; success before commitNote, failure before dispatch.fail | Entire trusted LLM conversion, generic job existing fields, all dispatch rows, quota reservation, Original, SourceBinding; dates normalized. Required for exact rollback only. |
| DriveLlmTerminalCall | After current guard, at the original completeLlm call; failure after original dispatch.fail and before original quota release | Original completeLlm base conversion, strict terminal outcome, single original now epoch, dispatch state and quota state at this call. Required for expected terminal state. |
| DriveAttempt | One immutable record per Tx invocation | Prewrite + terminal-call references; duplicate beforeWrite or terminal call rejects. Not an observed-terminal expectation. |
| DriveTerminal | Original callback and original awaiting continuation | Same proof/lease/job/outcome/body closure, current invocation count and immutable recorded attempt. |

Successful order: original current/media/abort guards → six-domain prewrite → commitNote/body/projection and Original/notices → original now1/terminal-call snapshot → original completeLlm/replace generic job → quota release → response scrub → original commit return → saved terminal confirmation.

Failure order: original identity/current owner fence → six-domain prewrite → dispatch.fail if applicable → original failure/cancel/unknown-delivery outcome → original now1/terminal-call snapshot → completeLlm → quota release → scrub → original Original restoration → original commit return → saved terminal confirmation. The prewrite never comes from fail-after, scrubbed, restored or body-written state. No local/PDF write ordering is moved.

Terminal expected-state predicate uses the recorded base/version+1, exact outcome, exact original terminal-call clock, closed owner, zero response budget, exact existing generic job fields with lease cleared, recorded dispatch→scrub state and recorded quota→released/preserved rule. It uses existing outcome.noteVersion, not a fictional generic result version or row version. SourceBinding immutable fields are compared independently of later cancellation/version; Original belongs to rollback capture, not a post-current terminal-current permission check.

Failed terminal outcome excludes both LLM_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN and LLM_DELIVERY_UNKNOWN. Only the original kind:"unknown"/LLM_DELIVERY_UNKNOWN branch retains possible delivery/quota meaning. Partial saved rows, version/outcome/clock/token-only matches, missing capture, consumed-copy or unknown read do not resolve a completion.

## Reentry state table and stop behavior

| Original invocation/read result | Next action | Forbidden action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No first write and known closed current rejection | Reject same original callback error; original worker failure branch may start its separate failure invocation | Fabricated failed terminal or changing previous expected data |
| Recorded Tx, exact saved terminal + same consumed genuine proof/lease | End same original commit continuation; owner callback/finally ends naturally | Replaying callback/body/ACK/write |
| Recorded Tx, exact all-six prewrite rollback | Clear only that proved rolled-back attempt, call the same original callback in the next original Tx, capture new original clock at its call | Expected from observed terminal, rebasing unknown attempt |
| Read missing/partial/unknown or saved neither expected nor exact prewrite | Keep immutable attempt and original caller pending | Reset/retry/ordinary release |
| Same invocation duplicate record | Original invalid-source rejection, held if closure/Tx uncertain | Overwriting prewrite or terminal call |
| Known current rejection on a proved rollback reentry before write | Same original rejection enters original failure callback; captures its own prewrite before dispatch.fail | Succeeding from old terminal or old callback outcome |

Candidate conservatively permits at most2 terminal Tx invocations for one immutable callback; after two proven rollbacks it remains held rather than guessing success or starting an unbounded retry. This is a candidate SOURCE bound, not an adopted actual budget. A known no-write rejection can enter the separate original failure callback, likewise bounded2; no retries occur while a previous attempt is unknown.

The Drive NodeLLM runner reuses its original timer1/2000ms and initial microtask, no start() and no added timer/deadline. Stop caches its original Promise, stops new admission, awaits any already-running admitting sweep, starts original execution.stop and keeps the original timer/wake in recover-only mode so late pending completion can resolve the original execution callback. No new claim/PDF preview/prune occurs in recover-only mode. Genuine maintenance error is sticky and rejects stop instead of pretending closure; a known current rejection is delivered to the original work callback. Finally clears the original timer, awaits active recovery, performs final recovery and input stage stop. Local/PDF runner shutdown stays its original branch. No private operation.done/deferred access or resolver is added.
